notes.title: Patch Notes (2024-12-24)
notes.content:
Patch Notes

Chapter 2 Boss: Reduced frame drops and adjusted mechanics
Arcade Zone: Adjusted bubble character movement speed
Bubble Visibility: Fixed an issue where bubbles were not visible
Continue Game Ghost: Fixed an issue where ghosts would not spawn in Continue Game mode
Trophy Achievement: Fixed an issue where the trophy achievement would not activate
